'''Abyssissa''' was the sixth<ref name="EA" /> and outermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Ea/Legends|Ea]] in the [[Geonosis system/Legends|Geonosis system]],<ref name="GW" /><ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Abyssissa was a [[Temperature/Legends|frozen]] rock with one [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="GW" /><ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Geonosis system/Legends|Geonosis system]], except [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] and [[Habon]], were introduced in the [[2004]] sourcebook ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''.<ref name="GW" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Geonosis star system in grid square R-16.<ref name="EA" />
